The anemia is small-celled with very low iron stores, as before, despite oral iron since August 2026.

The tissue transglutaminase IgA of 92 U/mL is more than six times the upper limit, with a normal total IgA. This strongly suggests celiac disease; a duodenal biopsy is usually needed to confirm it.

Vitamin D is low. ALT is mildly high, which can be seen with untreated celiac disease; suggest repeating it once treatment has started.
